FROM --platform=linux/x86_64 ubuntu:20.04
ARG DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
ENV TZ=Etc/UTC
SHELL ["/bin/bash", "-c"]

# Install software-properties-common first to add deadsnakes PPA
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    software-properties-common \
    wget \
    git \
    curl \
    ca-certificates \
    build-essential \
    && add-apt-repository ppa:deadsnakes/ppa \
    && apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    python3.11 \
    python3.11-venv \
    python3.11-distutils \
    python3-pip \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Upgrade pip for python3.11 and install virtualenv
RUN python3.11 -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel virtualenv

# Create virtual environment named "testbed"
RUN python3.11 -m virtualenv /opt/testbed

ENV VIRTUAL_ENV=/opt/testbed
ENV PATH="$VIRTUAL_ENV/bin:$PATH"

# Clone repository and checkout specific commit
RUN git clone https://github.com/MLSysOps/MLE-agent.git /testbed
WORKDIR /testbed
RUN git checkout dd7da4e5ac4085fb8324cac3ac0b4c104b9007cb

# Upgrade pip and setuptools inside the virtualenv
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir --upgrade pip setuptools wheel

# Install repository in editable mode so tests run against cloned code
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -e .

# Install listed dependencies from requirements_txt_dependencies
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir \
    "py7zr~=0.22.0" \
    "openai~=1.34.0" \
    "pandas~=2.2.2" \
    "tree-sitter==0.21.3" \
    "numexpr~=2.10.1" \
    "bottleneck~=1.4.0" \
    "google-api-python-client~=2.143.0" \
    "google-auth-httplib2~=0.2.0" \
    "google-auth-oauthlib~=1.2.1" \
    "lancedb~=0.15.0" \
    rich \
    click \
    pyyaml \
    kaggle \
    fastapi \
    uvicorn \
    requests \
    chromadb \
    GitPython \
    onnxruntime \
    questionary \
    tavily-python \
    instructor \
    langfuse \
    setuptools

# Explicitly reset workdir to /testbed
WORKDIR /testbed

# Automatically activate virtual environment on bash login
RUN echo "source /opt/testbed/bin/activate" >> /root/.bashrc

[CONTENT OF TEST PATCH]

# Activate the virtual environment
source /opt/testbed/bin/activate

# Run only the specified test file using unittest, output concise info (module=script path w/o .py)
python -m unittest -v tests.test_memory_api
rc=$?

Packages
========
The packages provided here are loosely based on the debian upstream packages with some modifications to make them more usable as non-default pythons and on ubuntu.  As such, the packages follow debian's patterns and often do not include a full python distribution with just `apt install python#.#`.  Here is a list of packages that may be useful along with the default install:
- `python#.#-dev`: includes development headers for building C extensions
- `python#.#-venv`: provides the standard library `venv` module
- `python#.#-distutils`: provides the standard library `distutils` module
- `python#.#-lib2to3`: provides the `2to3-#.#` utility as well as the standard library `lib2to3` module
- `python#.#-gdbm`: provides the standard library `dbm.gnu` module
- `python#.#-tk`: provides the standard library `tkinter` module
Third-Party Python Modules
==========================
Python modules in the official Ubuntu repositories are packaged to work with the Python interpreters from the official repositories. Accordingly, they generally won't work with the Python interpreters from this PPA. As an exception, pure-Python modules for Python 3 will work, but any compiled extension modules won't.
To install 3rd-party Python modules, you should use the common Python packaging tools.  For an introduction into the Python packaging ecosystem and its tools, refer to the Python Packaging User Guide:
https://packaging.python.org/installing/
